title: Weekly Strategy Session

frameworks.name: Completion with Integrity
frameworks.definition: Look, micromanagement is almost never an ego problem. It is an information architecture breakdown. When you step back in, you're not doing it because you crave control; you're doing it because your system is bleeding signal. That friction is burning out your nervous system.
frameworks.core_mechanism: The reality is, top performers don't fail because of capability; they fail against ambiguous standards. In our practice, we use a framework called Completion with Integrity. Before anyone starts a strategic initiative, you define the binary exit criteria upfront. You stop asking 'How is this going?' and start enforcing pre-agreed handoff constraints. When clarity goes up, surveillance drops to zero.
frameworks.application: Mark D. is defining exit criteria for the enterprise audit and stepping away from the daily review.
